title: Alert fatigue is breaking compliance. Theta Lake has a fix
hook_text: Up to 99 percent are false positives
script:
Up to ninety-nine percent of lexicon hits turn out to be false positives.
Theta Lake launched an AI feature designed to strip away noise and tackle alert fatigue.
Traditional surveillance methods rely on isolated keywords and short text fragments.
Specialized machine learning models automate reviews to cut through endless compliance noise.
Teams can now prioritize high risk items and streamline queues instead of wasting hours.
Would you trust AI to handle your firm compliance review?
